skill.name: amazon-competitor-analyzer
skill.description: Analyze Amazon competitors from ASINs with BrowserAct automation. The skill collects product data, compares pricing and review metrics, and creates local reports.
skill.summary: Collect Amazon ASIN data with BrowserAct and compare competitor pricing, reviews, and positioning.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill makes intended network requests to BrowserAct, reads a BrowserAct API key from environment or .env settings, and writes local report files. No prompt-injection text or hidden exfiltration was found, but API-key handling, external service use, file writes, and automated Amazon scraping need user trust and clear warnings.

remediation.issue: Broad .env loading can import more secrets than the skill needs.
remediation.suggestion: Only read BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the environment and avoid manually importing arbitrary .env keys.

remediation.issue: The BrowserAct API key is transmitted to an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Document the exact BrowserAct endpoint, avoid logging secrets, and require user confirmation before authenticated network calls.

remediation.issue: Report generation writes files to a user-selected output directory.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve output paths, reject sensitive directories, and warn before overwriting existing amazon_analysis files.

remediation.issue: The skill automates collection of Amazon marketplace data.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance for permission, rate limits, and terms compliance before users run large ASIN collections.

content.value_statement: Manual competitor research on Amazon is slow and hard to compare. This skill collects ASIN data through BrowserAct and creates pricing, rating, and report outputs.
actual_capabilities: Submits user-provided ASINs to a BrowserAct workflow template.
Polls BrowserAct task status until completion or timeout.
Retrieves BrowserAct task results for scraped Amazon product data.
Compares prices, ratings, review counts, and brands across ASINs.
Writes CSV, Markdown, and JSON reports to a local output directory.
Validates ASIN format and extracts ASIN-like tokens from text.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key and network access.
Accuracy depends on BrowserAct workflow output and Amazon page availability.
It does not verify compliance with Amazon terms or regional data rules.
Reports may overwrite files named amazon_analysis.* in the selected output directory.

use_cases.title: Benchmark Product Listings
use_cases.description: Compare competing ASINs by price, rating, review volume, brand, and extracted product details.

use_cases.title: Prepare Market Research Briefs
use_cases.description: Create CSV and Markdown outputs that summarize competitor positions for a product category.

use_cases.title: Check Pricing Gaps
use_cases.description: Identify the lowest and highest priced products in a selected ASIN set.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One ASIN
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to analyze ASIN B09G9GB4MG. Summarize the collected price, rating, review count, and brand.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Three Products
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze ASINs B09G9GB4MG, B08N5WRWNW, and B07ABC11111. Compare pricing, ratings, and review volume.

prompt_templates.title: Create Local Reports
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these ASINs and save the CSV, Markdown, and JSON reports in ./competitor-output.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Market Position
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this competitor ASIN set. Identify pricing leaders, review leaders, weak listings, and possible product positioning gaps.

output_examples.input: Analyze one ASIN for price and review basics.
output_examples.output: A concise product summary with title, brand, current price, rating, review count, and any missing fields.

output_examples.input: Compare three ASINs and generate reports.
output: Markdown report with pricing and rating leaders.
Summary of products that failed collection.

output_examples.input: Find competitive gaps across a category sample.
output_examples.output: A market position summary showing price range, highest rated product, review leaders, and candidate opportunities.

best_practices: Use only ASINs you are allowed to research and monitor.
Store the BrowserAct API key in a local secret manager or protected environment variable.
Review generated reports before sharing them with stakeholders.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for unauthorized scraping or excessive automated collection.
Do not pass real API keys directly in shared prompts or logs.
Do not write reports into sensitive directories or shared system paths.

faq.question: Does this skill require a BrowserAct account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a BrowserAct API key before it can submit workflow tasks.

faq.question: Can it analyze multiple ASINs at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The Python entry point accepts one or more ASINs and processes them sequentially.

faq.question: What files can it create?
faq.answer: It can create CSV, Markdown, and JSON reports named amazon_analysis in the chosen output directory.

faq.question: Does it guarantee accurate Amazon data?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on BrowserAct workflow output, page availability, and product page structure.

faq.question: Is the API key hardcoded?
faq.answer: No real key is hardcoded. The skill reads a BrowserAct API key from arguments or environment settings.

faq.question: Does it check legal or terms compliance?
faq.answer: No. Users must confirm that their scraping and analysis comply with applicable rules.
